document_zh: 条件化制度载体：五类发起主体 × 五条配置轴
document_en: A conditional institutional scaffold: five classes of sponsor across five axes of configuration

statement_zh: 本文件是条件化设计，不是主体安排。五类发起主体是类型学，不是名单：本文件不点名任何真实机构、企业、高校或社会组织，也不代表任何一方已同意、已接洽或已表达意向。
截至登记日，本方案团队未与任何场地方、运营主体或授权主体发生接触，不存在任何意向、约定或承诺。任何以本文件推断某一真实主体已参与的读法均不成立。
全部条目状态为 unknown：五类的配置差异写的是「若属这一类则如何配置」，不是「已经这样配置」。真实主体出现后按落位程序填写，未填写前不得据此申报任何闸门通过。
本文件不推荐任何一类。选择权属于取得授权的主体；本方案的立场只在一处：无论哪一类，闸门持有者与执行主体必须分离。
statement_en: This is conditional design, not an arrangement of parties. The five classes are a typology and not a list: no real institution, company, university or civil-society body is named here, and nothing here represents anyone as having agreed, been approached, or expressed interest.

As of the registration date the team has approached no site owner, operator or authorising body, and no intent, arrangement or commitment exists. No reading that infers the involvement of any real party from this file stands.

Every entry is unknown in status: what the five classes set out is how things would be configured if a sponsor belongs to that class, not how anything is configured. Once a real sponsor exists the entries are filled under the stated procedure, and until they are, no gate may be declared passed on the strength of this file.
No class is recommended. The choice belongs to an authorised body, and this proposal takes a position on one point only: whoever holds the gate must be separate from whoever executes, in every class.
declaration.relation_to_existing_register_zh: 本文件不替代也不重述 visual/assets/sensory-design-code.json 的机构架构一节：该节已登记三种候选形态（IF-1 政府平台公司、IF-2 公园运营方扩权、IF-3 多方联合体）的适配判据、前提与缺口，以及闸门持有者原则与成本量级结构。本文件做两件该节未做的事：其一，把三种形态扩为五类发起主体，补入高校联合体与社会组织联合两类；其二，对每一类沿五条配置轴逐项展开差异。三类既有形态的适配判据、前提与缺口不在此重述，只在对应类目下以 maps_to_existing 字段指认。
declaration.relation_to_existing_register_en: This file neither replaces nor restates the institutional-framework section of visual/assets/sensory-design-code.json, which already registers the fitness criteria, preconditions and gaps of three candidate forms — IF-1 a government platform company, IF-2 a widened remit for the park operator, IF-3 a multi-party consortium — together with the gate-holder principle and the structure of cost magnitude. It does two things that section does not: it widens the three forms into five classes of sponsor by adding a university consortium and a civil-society alliance, and it sets out, axis by axis, how configuration differs by class. The fitness, preconditions and gaps of the three existing forms are not repeated; each class points to them through its maps_to_existing field.

configuration_axes.rule_zh: A 角色须为单一、可署名、在项目周期之外仍然存在的位置。联合形态不得以分摊代替署名——把一个空缺分给更多主体，得到的仍是空缺。
configuration_axes.rule_en: The accountable role must be a single, nameable position that outlives the project cycle. A joint form may not substitute apportionment for a signature: spreading a blank across more parties still leaves a blank.

configuration_axes.name_en: How the G3 review seat is appointed
configuration_axes.rule_zh: 闸门持有者须独立于执行主体，这一条既有原则在本轴上进一步问：由谁任命、任命对象从哪里来。执行主体自行任命自己的复核人，等同于被审对象任命审查者，本文件登记为不成立。
configuration_axes.rule_en: The gate holder must be independent of the executing body; on this axis that existing principle is pressed further to ask who appoints and from where. An executing body appointing its own reviewer is the examined party appointing the examiner, and is registered here as not standing.

configuration_axes.rule_zh: 既有两条回避纪律适用于全部五类：每道闸门的证据所有者与复核人须为不同的人，G3 复核人还须未参与制作；维护方作为被审对象的作者，不得在现场审计与停止决定两类活动上担任执行或复核。本轴在此之上登记各类主体特有的利益冲突面。
configuration_axes.rule_en: Two recusal disciplines already in force apply to all five: at each gate the evidence owner and the reviewer are different people, and the G3 reviewer additionally took no part in making what is reviewed; and the maintainer, being the author of what is examined, holds neither the executing nor the reviewing role on site audits and stop decisions. On top of that, this axis registers the conflict surface peculiar to each class.

configuration_axes.name_zh: 经费来源与底线暴露面
configuration_axes.name_en: Funding source and the exposure of the floor
configuration_axes.rule_zh: 本轴登记该类主体默认落在四种承担机制中的哪一种，以及由此产生的非 AI 通道底线暴露面。付款方字段自 L1 起必填，自 L3 起状态必须为已确认——付款方未确认的服务不得进入限定开放，这条既有规则在本轴上是硬约束而不是提示。
configuration_axes.rule_en: This axis registers which of the four bearing mechanisms a class defaults to and what that exposes of the non-AI channel floor. The funding-owner field is mandatory from L1 and must read confirmed from L3: a service whose payer is unconfirmed does not enter bounded opening, and on this axis that existing rule is a hard constraint rather than a reminder.

configuration_axes.rule_zh: 本轴登记该类主体能自闭合到哪一开放层级，以及哪些事项必须外部闭合。法定审批事项在任何一类下一律外部，扩权与联合都不改变这一点。
configuration_axes.rule_en: This axis registers how far up the opening levels a class can close matters within itself and which matters must be closed outside it. Statutory approvals lie outside in every class, and neither a widened remit nor a consortium changes that.
configuration_axes.source: visual/assets/sensory-design-code.json#IF-2 / proposal.md#更新过程本身的公共利益

sponsor_classes.trigger_zh: 发起主体具备跨主体缔约能力，且其设立目的包含代行属地统筹事项。
sponsor_classes.trigger_en: The sponsor can contract across parties and was set up, among other purposes, to carry out local coordination on behalf of the district.

configuration.a_role_zh: 由该主体内部指定单一署名 A，且该 A 不得同时持有 G3 席位。
configuration.a_role_en: A single named accountable role from inside the body, which may not also hold a G3 seat.
configuration.g3_appointment_zh: G3 席位的任命权须与执行权分离并留痕：任命由该主体之外的第三方作出，任命过程按双联交接结构留下可核对痕迹。本类的特有风险是自己任命自己的复核人。
configuration.g3_appointment_en: The power to appoint the G3 seat is separated from the power to execute and leaves a trace: a third party outside the body appoints, and the appointment leaves a checkable trace on the duplicate-handover structure. The risk peculiar to this class is a body appointing its own reviewer.
configuration.recusal_zh: 该主体若同时是场地出租方或供应商股东，则在与该场地、该供应商相关的停止决定与验收事项上整体回避。
configuration.recusal_en: Where the body is also the site's landlord or a shareholder in a supplier, it recuses itself entirely from stop decisions and acceptance matters touching that site or that supplier.
configuration.funding_zh: 默认落公共财政全担。暴露面在预算的年度性：底线三项中的预算项最易随年度调整而变，须以复审到期日与付款方状态双重登记对冲。
configuration.funding_en: Defaults to full public funding. The exposure is the annual nature of a budget: of the three floor items the budget one shifts most easily with the annual round, and is hedged by registering both a review-due date and the payer's status.
configuration.approval_zh: 可自闭合到 L1—L2；L3 起涉及公共空间开放与安全审批的事项须外部闭合，法定审批事项一律外部。
configuration.approval_en: Can close matters within itself up to L1 and L2; from L3 anything touching the opening of public space or safety approval closes outside, and statutory approvals always do.

sponsor_classes.binding_gap_zh: 数据治理活动在既有五角色矩阵中没有执行角色对应者，本类不自动填补该缺口，仍须由授权主体另行指定第六个角色；未指定前测量记录不得开始。
sponsor_classes.binding_gap_en: The data-governance activity has no executing role among the five in the existing matrix, and this class does not fill that gap by itself; a sixth role must be named by the authorising body, and until it is, measurement records may not begin.

sponsor_classes.trigger_zh: 发起主体是主脊所依托的现状街道基底、作为参照系的廊道公共空间，或某一重点区场地的日常运营者，动作落在其既有维护半径之内。
sponsor_classes.trigger_en: The sponsor is the day-to-day operator of the existing street ground the spine is organised on, of the corridor public space that serves as the reference frame, or of a site in one key area, and the actions fall inside its existing maintenance radius.

configuration.a_role_zh: 运营方内部可署名 A，权限限定在可撤除构件与限定开放测试，不延伸到法定审批事项。
configuration.a_role_en: A nameable accountable role inside the operator, with a remit bounded to removable components and bounded-open testing and not extending to statutory approvals.
configuration.g3_appointment_zh: 运营方不得任命 G3 席位；席位须由场地之外的主体任命，否则被审对象任命审查者。
configuration.g3_appointment_en: The operator does not appoint the G3 seat; it is appointed by a body outside the site, or the examined party is appointing the examiner.
configuration.recusal_zh: 运营方在涉及自身运营绩效的复核事项上回避——开放时长、故障与恢复两个年度公开字段直接评价其本职工作。
configuration.recusal_en: The operator recuses itself from review matters bearing on its own operating performance: two of the annual public fields, opening hours and fault-and-recovery, assess its own job directly.
configuration.funding_zh: 默认落场地方承担。暴露面最直接：底线与经营目标同源，可见性与值守两项与经营时段绑定，闭园即断，「不消费也能停留」是第一冲突点。
configuration.funding_en: Defaults to the site party bearing the cost. The exposure is the most direct of all: the floor and the commercial objective share a source, visibility and staffing are tied to trading hours and end when the gates close, and staying without spending is the first point of conflict.
configuration.approval_zh: 自闭合范围最小但闭合最快；铁路资产与区级事项不在其权限内，凡涉及此二者的动作须另设联合机制。
configuration.approval_en: Closes the narrowest range within itself but closes it fastest; rail assets and district matters lie outside its remit and anything touching them needs a joint mechanism.

sponsor_classes.binding_gap_zh: 本类天然承担 FA-3 人力科目，因此在劳动力短缺情景下同时是最有能力维持值守与最有动机削减值守的一方；该双重身份须在 G0 即写入回避与公示安排。
sponsor_classes.binding_gap_en: This class naturally carries the labour account, which makes it at once the party best able to sustain stewarding and the party most motivated to cut it. That double role is written into the recusal and disclosure arrangements at G0.

sponsor_classes.trigger_zh: 发起主体为一个或多个高等院校、科研机构组成的联合体，参与动机以研究产出与教学为主。
sponsor_classes.trigger_en: The sponsor is a consortium of one or more universities or research institutes whose motive is chiefly research output and teaching.

configuration.a_role_zh: A 角色须落在联合体的常设执行机构，不得落在某一课题组：课题组随项目周期解散，A 角色不能随之消失。无常设执行机构者，本类不成立——这是硬前提而不是建议。
configuration.a_role_en: The accountable role sits with the consortium's standing executive body and never with a project group: project groups dissolve with the funding cycle and the accountable role cannot dissolve with them. Without a standing executive body this class does not stand — a hard precondition, not a suggestion.
configuration.g3_appointment_zh: 联合体成员单位的人员不得担任本联合体项目的 G3 复核人；席位须含非学术界的参与者代表。本类的特有风险是把独立复核做成同行评议——两者的形式相似而独立性来源相反。
configuration.g3_appointment_en: Nobody from a member institution reviews that consortium's own project at G3, and the seat must include participant representatives from outside academia. The risk peculiar to this class is turning independent review into peer review: the two look alike and draw their independence from opposite places.
configuration.recusal_zh: 研究产出与被审对象同源时回避。另登记一条本文件新增判据：发表压力不构成恢复条件——停止条件已触发时，论文、结项或评估周期都不是重开的理由。
configuration.recusal_en: Recusal applies where the research output and the object under review share a source. One criterion is added here: publication pressure is not a resume condition — once a stop condition has fired, neither a paper, a project closeout nor an assessment cycle is a reason to reopen.
configuration.funding_zh: 默认落公共财政全担或混合分担。暴露面在项目周期：课题经费按项目期结算，而值守与年度运维是逐年重复科目，项目结束即断。因此本类必须在 L4a 之前把付款方从课题主体转出，否则复审到期即按 L0 报告。
configuration.funding_en: Defaults to full public funding or to a mixed arrangement. The exposure is the project cycle: research money settles at the end of a project while stewarding and annual upkeep repeat year on year, so they stop when the project does. This class must therefore move the payer off the project entity before L4a, or the node reports as L0 the moment the review falls due.
configuration.approval_zh: 校内伦理审查可覆盖参与者事项，与 G0 的六份协议对齐；公共空间构件、运营与安全事项一律外部闭合。
configuration.approval_en: An internal ethics review can cover participant matters and lines up with the six protocols at G0; components in public space, operations and safety all close outside.

sponsor_classes.binding_gap_zh: 本类最容易满足研究方法与伦理条件，最不容易满足运维连续性；若无法在 L4a 之前完成付款方转出，本类的合理终点是 L3 而不是 L4b，登记为终点而不是失败。
sponsor_classes.binding_gap_en: This class meets research method and ethics conditions most easily and continuity of upkeep least easily. Where the payer cannot be moved before L4a, its proper end point is L3 rather than L4b — registered as an end point, not as a failure.

sponsor_classes.trigger_zh: 发起主体为依法登记的社会组织或其联合形式，参与动机以服务对象权益为主。
sponsor_classes.trigger_en: The sponsor is a lawfully registered civil-society organisation or an alliance of such bodies whose motive is chiefly the rights of the people it serves.

configuration.a_role_zh: 可署名 A 通常存在且最接近使用者，但资源承载力最弱。硬前提是 A 角色须附一份可执行的资源来源声明，否则该 A 只是名义 A——一个无法调动值守与维护资源的署名，不满足 A 的定义。
configuration.a_role_en: A nameable accountable role usually exists and stands closest to the user, but the capacity behind it is the thinnest. The hard precondition is that the role carries an executable statement of where its resources come from; without it the role is nominal, and a signature that cannot command stewarding or maintenance does not meet the definition.
configuration.g3_appointment_zh: 本类最容易满足复核人未参与制作，但须防另一种同源：服务对象代表同时是该组织的服务使用者时，在涉及该组织自身绩效的事项上须另设代表。
configuration.g3_appointment_en: This class most easily meets the rule that reviewers did not build the thing, but must guard against a second shared source: where a participant representative is also a user of that organisation's services, a separate representative is seated on matters bearing on the organisation's own performance.
configuration.recusal_zh: 组织的资助方若同时是技术供应商，则该组织在采购与供应商独立性事项上整体回避。
configuration.recusal_en: Where a funder of the organisation is also a technology supplier, the organisation recuses itself entirely from procurement and supplier-independence matters.
configuration.funding_zh: 默认落混合分担。暴露面最广：底线三项全部依赖外部资助的连续性，任一资助周期中断即三项同时暴露。因此本类在 L3 申报时须把三项承诺的承担方分列，不得合并为一个来源。
configuration.funding_en: Defaults to a mixed arrangement. Its exposure is the widest: all three floor items depend on the continuity of outside funding, so one broken funding cycle exposes all three at once. When declaring L3 this class lists a bearer for each of the three commitments separately and may not merge them into one source.
configuration.approval_zh: 自闭合能力最弱，多数事项须借道其他主体；本类单独发起时，多数动作的合理停留层级是 L1—L2。
configuration.approval_en: Closes the least within itself and must route most matters through other bodies; where this class sponsors alone, most actions properly rest at L1 or L2.

sponsor_classes.binding_gap_zh: 本类在参与结构与使用者代表性上条件最好，在资源与审批上条件最差。两者不可互换：参与做得好不能替代付款方确认，付款方未确认即不得进入限定开放。
sponsor_classes.binding_gap_en: This class is best placed on participation structure and user representation and worst placed on resources and approvals. The two are not interchangeable: doing participation well does not substitute for a confirmed payer, and without one there is no bounded opening.

sponsor_classes.trigger_zh: 发起主体为两类以上主体组成的联合体，通常出现在四方在场且无一方可单独闭合全部事项时。
sponsor_classes.trigger_en: The sponsor is a consortium of bodies of more than one class, which typically arises where four parties are present and none can close every matter alone.

configuration.a_role_zh: 单一可署名 A（既有前提）。本文件补一条：A 席位所在方须同时是承担人力科目的一方，否则出现负责的人不发工资、发工资的人不负责的结构。
configuration.a_role_en: A single nameable accountable role, as already required. One addition here: the party holding that role must also be the party carrying the labour account, or the structure ends with the accountable party not paying the wages and the paying party not accountable.
configuration.g3_appointment_zh: 由联合体协议在成立时指定外部任命人，且该指定不得在争议发生后变更——不可回溯，沿用阈值预注册的同一纪律。
configuration.g3_appointment_en: The consortium agreement names an outside appointer at the outset, and that naming may not change once a dispute has arisen: non-retroactive, on the same discipline as pre-registered thresholds.
configuration.recusal_zh: 谁执行停止须在成立时写明，这是既有缺口的直接闭合动作；未写明者，停止条件在多主体之间失去责任落点，该联合体不得申报 L3 以上。
configuration.recusal_en: Who carries out a stop is written down at the outset, which closes the gap already registered; without it a stop condition loses its point of accountability among the parties and the consortium may not declare above L3.
configuration.funding_zh: 默认落混合分担。暴露面在分摊可谈判：底线三项若按比例分摊，任一方退出即三项同时出现缺口，且恢复责任无落点。配置要求是三项逐项指定单一承担方——允许三项分属不同主体，不允许任一项按比例分摊。
configuration.funding_en: Defaults to a mixed arrangement. Its exposure is that shares are negotiable: if the three floor items are split by proportion, one party leaving opens a gap in all three at once with no one to close it. The configuration requirement is a single bearer for each item — the three may sit with different parties, but no single item is split by proportion.
configuration.approval_zh: 覆盖面最广、协调成本最高；每一次跨主体动作按双联交接台账留痕，痕迹缺失即视为协调未发生。
configuration.approval_en: Covers the widest ground at the highest coordination cost; every cross-party action leaves its trace on the duplicate handover ledger, and a missing trace counts as coordination not having happened.

sponsor_classes.binding_gap_zh: 本类把其余四类的缺口一并继承，同时新增一处：主体越多，停止条件越容易被稀释。因此本类的成立条件不是「谁都能参加」，而是「谁来叫停」在成立当天就有答案。
sponsor_classes.binding_gap_en: This class inherits the gaps of the other four and adds one: the more parties, the easier a stop condition is to dilute. What makes it stand is therefore not that anyone may join but that the question of who calls a halt has an answer on the day it is formed.

steps_zh: 第一步 类型判定：按各类 trigger 判定发起主体所属类别；同时符合两类者按其可署名 A 所在的主体判定，不得同时申报两类。
第二步 五轴填写：逐轴填入实际配置，未确认者保持 null，不得以模板值或目标值填充。
第三步 更新开办条件：将 A 角色结果回填 GD-2（责任角色表），将经费结果回填 GD-4（两类预算），并同步更新付款方字段状态。本文件不触及 GD-1（场地授权）与 GD-3（许可与保险）——五条轴产不出这两项的证据，回填它们等于以制度设计冒充授权文件。
第四步 独立复核：由未参与制作的专业人员与参与者代表在 G3 逐项核对回避与任命路径；本文件的任何一类配置未经该复核不得视为成立。
steps_en: One, classify: identify the sponsor's class by the triggers. Where two fit, the class follows the body holding the nameable accountable role, and no sponsor declares two classes at once.
Two, fill the five axes: enter the actual configuration axis by axis, leaving anything unconfirmed as null and never filling it with a template or target value.

Three, update readiness: carry the accountable-role result back into GD-2, the accountability matrix, and the funding result back into GD-4, the two budget conditions, updating the payer field's status with them. This file does not touch GD-1, the site permission, or GD-3, permits and insurance: the five axes produce no evidence for either, and filling them in would be institutional design passing itself off as an authorisation.

Four, review independently: professionals who took no part in making the thing, with participant representatives, check recusal and the appointment route item by item at G3; no configuration in this file stands without that review.

non_fabrication_clause_zh: 五类为类型学，不是名单。本文件不点名任何真实机构、企业、高校或社会组织，不表述任何一方已同意、已接洽或已表达意向，也不代任何一方作出承诺。伪造官方背书属征集的强制拒绝条件，本文件的全部条目据此写作条件句：主体尚未出现，配置先写完，落位待真实主体。
non_fabrication_clause_en: The five classes are a typology and not a list. No real institution, company, university or civil-society body is named here; nobody is described as having agreed, been approached or expressed interest; and no commitment is made on anyone's behalf. Fabricating official endorsement is a mandatory ground for rejection in this call, and every entry here is written accordingly as a conditional: the sponsor has not appeared, the configuration is written in advance, and filling it in waits on a real one.
limitations_zh: 本文件是条件化制度设计的登记，不是治理方案、组织章程、合作协议或授权文件。
全部 null 与 unknown 为如实空缺，落位程序与填写者逐项写明，条件未满足前保持空缺。
本文件不产生任何指标数值，也不改变服务桌七项开办条件的当前结论（具备 0 项）。
五条配置轴中除明示为本文件新增者外，全部指向包内既有纪律，不新设治理程序。
limitations_en: This registers conditional institutional design. It is not a governance scheme, a constitution, a partnership agreement or an authorisation.
Every null and unknown is a truthful blank; the procedure and the owner for filling each are stated, and until the conditions are met the blanks remain.
It produces no metric value and does not change the current finding on the desk's seven readiness conditions, of which none is met.
Except where an entry says otherwise, all five axes point to disciplines already in the package and create no new governance procedure.
